story.heading:
Built step by step.
Designed to grow together.
story.intro: Our story is not about one service. It is about building specialized companies that can grow independently and create more value together.

items.title: A shared vision
items.text: Afghan Power began with a simple idea: bring practical, professional services together around the real needs of Afghan clients.

items.title: Specialized divisions
items.text: The group expanded into focused teams for education, travel, technology and media while keeping one unified standard of service.

items.title: Integrated solutions
items.text: Today, our divisions work independently where expertise matters and together where clients benefit from connected services.

items.title: Building what comes next
items.text: We continue to grow our products, partnerships and capabilities with a long-term focus on useful innovation and dependable support.

leaders.name: M. Samim Meyakhail
